messages:
sam: Heads-up: perf alert during the evening traffic test. P50 host parse for short text requests climbed ~1.1ms. Traces attached.

elena: Saw the spike on graphs. I pulled a perf flame and the extra time is in request_deserialize -> proto_unmarshal -> memcpy. Oddly, GPU-side kernels look unchanged.

diego: Could be fragmentation from streaming chunking. We recently tightened stream_chunk_cutoff in the ingress path to reduce tail latencies for large requests. That makes many small writes for small payloads.
sam: Confirmed. Syscall monitor shows a bump in writev calls per request from 1 -> 3 on averages.

elena: Also, kernel selector bumped min_batch_to_qint8 for some small-batch kernels last week. That change increases host prepack steps for tiny batches. Maybe combined effect.

diego: Quick experiment: I disabled the new chunk_cutoff on a canary and ran the small-request harness. P50 dropped back ~0.9ms. So chunking fragmentation is major factor.

perf-bot: Regression detector: host_parse_cpu +22% and syscall_rate +15% vs baseline for traffic profile: small-chat-1000. Commits implicated: cherry/ingress-stream-cutoff and infra/kernel-pref-2026. See /perf/1967004321/report.

sam: Two options: revert chunk cutoff change, or implement a writev coalescer in the ingress proxy to batch small fragments for the same fd within a small time window. Coalescer likely lower-risk.

elena: I can prototype a coalescer that buffers up to 256B or 2ms before flush. Should keep large-request latency unaffected.
diego: Make sure the coalescer respects streaming semantics for deadlines and flush-on-end-of-stream. Also add telemetry for coalesce_ratio.
sam: Good call. Diego, can you own a canary with coalescer toggled? Elena, PR to follow. I'll coordinate alerts.
diego: Will run canary and measure tokenization-only path and end-to-end. Also add kvcache hit/miss latency histograms to ensure no unexpected KV interaction.
elena: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ingress-proxy/pull/521 - implements coalescer + tests.

perf-bot: Canary snapshot (initial): host_parse median improved -0.8ms with coalescer; syscall_rate down 11%. kvcache latencies unchanged in 95/99 percentiles.
sam: Nice. One more test: enable the kernel selector change + coalescer together to ensure no residual regression. Diego, schedule that AB.
diego: AB started. Early numbers look promising: combined change roughly at baseline, P99 tail unchanged. I'll let it run for 3h.

ops-bot: FYI deployed ingress coalescer to canary cluster 'canary-7' at 2026-03-23T01:12:00Z.

elena: After 3h AB: no significant regressions. Coalescer reduces small-write syscalls and kernel selector stays enabled. Suggest promote kernel selector rollout and keep coalescer in proxy.
sam: Agreed. We'll ship coalescer to prod with rollout stage gating and keep kvcache tail alert for 48h. Thanks everyone. :clap:
